purpose: Test a finite, causal BTC benchmark-state gate over fixed ETH target signals without importing Freqtrade performance or winner parameters.

market_data.alignment: exact completed hourly timestamps only; no future-bar forward fill
market_data.execution: enter at next available hourly open t+1 and exit at the hourly open 24 completed bars later

asset_selection_rationale.benchmark: BTC-USD is the preregistered benchmark role from the parent family.
asset_selection_rationale.target: ETH-USD is fixed as the single Batch A target because it is already present in the Factory Coinbase hourly contract and avoids selecting targets from the externally observed positive/negative replication list.

benchmark_states.definition: RV24_t <= median of prior 720 completed RV24 observations; RV24 is sample standard deviation of the prior 24 hourly BTC log returns and the threshold window excludes RV24_t
BTC close_t / max(BTC close over completed t-719..t) - 1 >= -0.10

target_signals.definition: ETH close_t > SMA72_t and ETH close_t_minus_1 <= SMA72_t_minus_1

interaction.candidate_rule: target signal true AND benchmark positive state true
interaction.baseline_rule: same target signal with no BTC gate
interaction.overlap_policy: while a position/event is open, additional entries for that candidate are ignored

candidate_construction.formula: 4 benchmark states x 3 ETH target signals x 1 gate form

costs.rationale: Reuse the already-frozen Coinbase hourly Factory cost convention from Grammar 008; no new cost fit.

decision_rule.discovery_pass: gated effect > 0 AND gated mean_net_primary > 0 AND gated mean_net_stress >= 0 AND gated mean_net_primary > ungated baseline mean_net_primary AND gated effect >= ungated baseline effect
decision_rule.validation_pass: discovery_pass AND validation gated effect > 0 AND validation gated mean_net_primary > 0 AND validation gated mean_net_stress >= 0 AND validation gated mean_net_primary > validation ungated baseline mean_net_primary AND validation gated effect >= validation ungated baseline effect
decision_rule.holdout_pass: validation_pass AND holdout gated effect > 0 AND holdout gated mean_net_primary > 0 AND holdout gated mean_net_stress >= 0 AND holdout gated mean_net_primary > holdout ungated baseline mean_net_primary AND holdout gated effect >= holdout ungated baseline effect

multiple_testing.family_search_space: all 12 candidates are one frozen family batch
multiple_testing.discovery_may_forward: all candidates independently satisfying the frozen discovery gate
